line: The last minute of the Artemis II launch, uncut: one cell opens to nine, and they merge into one at ignition.
line_cn: 阿尔忒弥斯二号发射的最后一分钟，一秒不剪：格子从 1 开到 9，点火合成 1。

motion.cuts: camera-led cuts: slide or push-through on motion

camera.expresses: One mapping, M = t − T0, for the whole film. Each camera has its own source offset (s = M + c) measured once and baked into the frame extraction (demo/tools/prep.sh): frames are named by film frame nu
Each layout change starts on the first word of a real call in the native audio ("ten", "go for…", "ignition", a name) or on an event visible in the footage. The music follows; it never sets a cut.
1 → 2 → 3–4 → many (6–9, the clock itself becomes the centre cell, the transcript a cell) → one at zero → a few again after zero (the event's consequences) → one under the title. The shortest layouts

transitions: Inside a cell, the source cuts itself (a broadcast switching cameras): keep it;
labels: Clock digits: a condensed sans with fixed-width digit slots (ours: Barlow Condensed SemiBold, drawn digit by digit in equal slots so the clock never jitters); size up to 132 px, the T−/T+ sign at 0.85×, tenths at 0.41× in grey, a ten-segment sub-second bar under it.

Chinese: a sturdy sans (ours: Noto Sans SC 500/700, subset). English text: a clean grotesque (Barlow). Labels, codes and English small print: a monospace (IBM Plex Mono). All OFL, in the project's fonts/.

The live transcript is the subtitle. A fixed box (bottom right, or a cell in the grid): a speaking light and the speaker type (commentary / loop / narrator — the narrator, our own voice, is marked in orange so it is never mistaken for the event's audio), the English line appearing word by word at the spoken times (0.08 s fade per word, a block cursor), the Chinese line whole when its cue starts. One line per language, never wrapped: a long sentence becomes two cues; each cue ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s). Transcribe only what is said; mark doubtful words in FACTS.md.
Reading time for everything else: CJK ÷ 4.5 + other ÷ 15 + 1.5 s from the moment it is complete (readcheck.mjs). A comparison (two bars, two numbers) stays fully on screen ≥ 2.5 s.
motion: 30 fps. Clock: on each whole second the new digits drop 14 px in 0.12 s (ease-out); the sub-second bar empties one segment per 0.1 s (fills after zero).

Re-layout: 0.34 s easeInOutCubic. Cells that stay interpolate their rectangles; new cells open from their left edge; leaving cells close to the left; a new cell flashes a 3 px orange border for ~0.2 s when it lands. A grid filling up pops one cell per spoken count in 0.30 s.
Swaps (one source replaces another in the same rectangle) wipe in from the left. Hard cuts only between full-screen sources.
Photographs push in ≤ 6 % over their whole stay; names pop one by one 0.16 s apart. Documents move their window down a row in 0.45 s; the highlight sweeps left to right in 0.35 s.

native_moves.name: Many into one
native_moves.does: At zero, every cell moves to its tile of the full frame (a 3×3 grid becomes nine 640×360 tiles) while each tile cross-fades to the same full-screen shot, chips and borders vanish in the first half, a warm white flash (rgba(255,248,236,.7), decay τ ≈ 0.11 s) peaks, and the clock and transcript slide from their grid cells back to the bottom. 0.42 s. Fits: a verdict read out; the goal at the final whistle.

native_moves.name: Clock inversion
native_moves.does: At zero the clock block flips from dark with an orange T− to orange with dark T+, and its header changes (countdown → elapsed). Fits: polls closing, a store opening.

native_moves.name: Control strip
native_moves.does: Segments in the clock header (who has control: ground → vehicle → mission control; prosecution → jury → judge); the active one fills orange on the call that hands it over, with a short flash. The story's turns live here.

native_moves.name: The grid fills on the count
native_moves.does: Empty grid slots show as dashed "standby" frames; each spoken number opens one camera. Fits: "three, two, one" before a premiere.

native_moves.name: Sync badge
native_moves.does: Top-right of each video cell: ● 实时同步 LIVE SYNC (synced), ○ 同一时段 · 未逐帧同步 SAME WINDOW (hatched, grey: footage from the same minutes without a usable clock), 慢动作还原 1× REAL-TIME (slow-motion re-timed). Honesty is part of the look.

native_moves.name: Planned vs heard checklist
native_moves.does: Official milestones with their planned times tick as the clock passes them; when the native audio actually says one, a red "heard −32.1" tag with a small waveform appears beside it. Fits: a court schedule against what was said; a train timetable against the platform announcement.

native_moves.name: Second countdown
native_moves.does: After zero, a smaller clock counts to the next official milestone (−1:47 to booster separation, expected T+2:09) along a schematic profile drawn by time, not distance. Fits: the next race split; the next ballot count.

native_moves.name: Event flag
native_moves.does: An orange bar with black type slides in at the bottom of the relevant cell on its call (RS-25 ×4 启动 ENGINE START · T−6.36), held ≥ the reading time.

native_moves.name: Punch-in on a call
native_moves.does: A hard digital punch-in on the relevant detail when the commentary names it, from a higher-resolution extraction of the same source.

native_moves.name: Document by rows
native_moves.does: A paper close-up shows two or three rows; a highlight bar and an annotation band below the paper translate the row; the window moves only between rows (its edges in the white space).

score.note: ticking pulse to zero, a quarter-second silence before ignition
